label: Require Supabase pgvector type in extensions

execute.sql: DO $$ BEGIN IF to_regtype('extensions.vector') IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Enable pgvector in extensions before the Knowledge migration'; END IF; END $$

postcheck.sql: SELECT to_regtype('extensions.vector') IS NOT NULL AS result

execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "public"."KnowledgeChunk" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "contentHash" text NOT NULL,
  "dimensions" int4 NOT NULL,
  "documentId" text NOT NULL,
  "documentVersion" text NOT NULL,
  "embedding" extensions.vector(1536) NOT NULL,
  "embeddingInputHash" text NOT NULL,
  "embeddingModel" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "language" text NOT NULL,
  "ordinal" int4 NOT NULL,
  "page" int4,
  "passageHash" text NOT NULL,
  "passageId" text NOT NULL,
  "provenanceHash" text NOT NULL,
  "reviewed" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "sources" json NOT NULL,
  "subject" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "knowledge_chunk_hashes_baf6cdf2" CHECK ("passageHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "contentHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "embeddingInputHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "provenanceHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  CONSTRAINT "knowledge_chunk_shape_ac4a864f" CHECK (dimensions = 1536 AND ordinal >= 0 AND (page IS NULL OR page > 0))
)

precheck.description: check RLS is not already enabled on "KnowledgeChunk"
precheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_class" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."relnamespace" WHERE ("n"."nspname" = $1 AND "c"."relname" = $2 AND NOT ("c"."relrowsecurity"))) AS "result"

execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."KnowledgeChunk" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

postcheck.description: verify row-level security is enabled on "KnowledgeChunk"
postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_class" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."relnamespace" WHERE ("n"."nspname" = $1 AND "c"."relname" = $2 AND "c"."relrowsecurity")) AS "result"

precheck.description: ensure RLS policy "knowledge_chunk_read_reviewed_72bac3b2" does not exist
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_policies" WHERE ("schemaname" = $1 AND "tablename" = $2 AND "policyname" = $3)) AS "result"

execute.sql: CREATE POLICY "knowledge_chunk_read_reviewed_72bac3b2" ON "public"."KnowledgeChunk" AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (reviewed = true)

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_policies" WHERE ("schemaname" = $1 AND "tablename" = $2 AND "policyname" = $3)) AS "result"

execute.sql: REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public."KnowledgeChunk" FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated
GRANT SELECT ON TABLE public."KnowledgeChunk" TO authenticated

postcheck.sql:
SELECT has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public."KnowledgeChunk"', 'SELECT')
          AND NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public."KnowledgeChunk"', 'INSERT')
          AND NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public."KnowledgeChunk"', 'UPDATE')
          AND NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public."KnowledgeChunk"', 'DELETE')
          AND NOT has_table_privilege('anon', 'public."KnowledgeChunk"', 'SELECT') AS result
